name: Aloha Sheet Metal
old_description: Aloha Sheet Metal LLC has been providing high quality air conditioning services for Maui and All Islands for 20 years.
about:
Aloha Sheet Metal operates from Kihei on the island of Maui, Hawaii, with a fabrication shop in the Pulehunui Industrial Park near Puunene. The family-owned and operated company has provided air conditioning and sheet metal services across Maui and the other Hawaiian islands for approximately 20 years, though a specific founding year is not published.

The company specializes in commercial and light commercial HVAC system installation and design. It runs a complete duct fabrication shop that produces custom ductwork and sheet metal components for its own installations and for outside projects. In addition to new installations, a dedicated service crew handles repairs and maintenance for equipment the company installs as well as for businesses needing HVAC service. Service offerings span air conditioning, heating, kitchen ventilation, and general ventilation systems, with custom sheet metal fabrication available to meet specific design requirements.

Customers include commercial property owners, light commercial businesses, and food-service operators requiring kitchen ventilation on Maui and neighboring islands. The firm works with general contractors and facility managers on new construction and retrofit projects, and it serves any business needing licensed HVAC repair.

Aloha Sheet Metal emphasizes that its in-house fabrication capability shortens lead times and allows parts to be built to exact design specifications, which the company says saves customers time and money. It holds a Hawaii contractor license for both sheet metal and air conditioning work.
